sections.title: Local Processing
sections.text: All image processing is performed directly in your browser. Your images and data never leave your device. No uploads, no cloud storage, and no external servers are involved.

sections.title: Your Preferences
sections.text: Application settings such as theme or language are stored locally in your browser to enhance your experience. You can clear these preferences at any time.

sections.title: No Account Required
sections.text: The application does not require registration, login, or personal information. You can start using it immediately.

sections.title: Agreement
sections.text: By using this application, you acknowledge and agree to the principles described above.

confirmResetLocalPreferences.title: Clear Preferences
confirmResetLocalPreferences.text: Are you sure you want to clear your stored preferences? This action will reset your settings to their default values.
